m: Potatoes: oven to 220°C. Cut into chunks, toss with oil, salt and rosemary, roast 35 to 40 minutes.
Slice each breast in half horizontally and flatten slightly between baking paper.
Season, lay a sage leaf on each, wrap with a slice of prosciutto and lightly dust the outside in flour.
Pan-fry in oil and a little butter, prosciutto side down first, 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
Sauce: add the rest of the butter, lemon juice and stock powder dissolved in ¼ cup water per 2 serves. Bubble 1 minute, scraping up the bits.
Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1 minute. Serve the chicken on the spinach with the sauce spooned over and potatoes alongside.
l: Chicken and potatoes together, sauce poured over. Reheat in the oven.
g: GF flour for dusting (or skip it) and check the stock powder. Cook the GF ones first.
